name: Michael J. Trenkwalder
headline: CEO at AurumCars (CHECK24 Group) | 🚀 We are hiring!
summary:
Michael is CEO at AurumCars (a CHECK24 Group company). AurumCars is a mobility services broker for domestic and international car, truck and RV rentals. Together with our global network of 250+ partners, we deliver a high-quality mobility experience across more than 100 countries worldwide. With dedicated teams working on booking, payment, check-in and claims management, we are committed to drive innovation across the full mobility experience. 

AurumCars has a rating of 4.4 out of 5.0 and has been awarded the TOP COMPANY AWARD 2023 by kununu based on own employee ratings of the past 12 months. 

Prior to joining AurumCars, Michael has spent 10+ years in management consulting at Bain & Company and Roland Berger. He has served clients in Automotive, Tech & Telecoms where he lead assignments focusing on Transformation, Strategy, NPS and M&A. Key assignments included projects such as big data strategy, automotive digitalization & market entry, large scale transformation/operating model and software portfolio optimization. His assignments span globally covering countries in the Americas, Europe, Middle East and Asia.

Michael holds an MBA from INSEAD (MBA 13 J), a Diploma in Economics from LMU, Munich and an Honors Degree in Technology Management from the Center for Digital Technology & Management (CDTM).

company.name: AurumCars GmbH
company.description:
AurumCars GmbH is a forward-thinking travel tech company based in Munich, Germany, specialising in global car rental distribution and innovative mobility solutions. By leveraging data, technology and strategic partnerships, we enable travellers to seamlessly access trusted rental brands around the world and empower rental suppliers to maximise reach and efficiency.

🌍 Our global sales channel: Planet Rentalcars
Our international branch, Planet Rentalcars, exemplifies our global ambition: operating in over 180 countries, collaborating with highly-regulated, trusted rental partners, and delivering a full-service premium experience for customers. Recognised as “Car Rental Services Provider of the Year – Munich 2025” by International Explorer, Planet Rentalcars integrates seamlessly into our travel tech ecosystem.

Together, AurumCars and Planet Rentalcars offer:

End-to-end digital rental journeys with transparent pricing and no hidden fees

24/7 customer service support to ensure smooth travel experiences

Advanced comparison and pricing technologies to secure the best offers globally

Driven by innovation, agility and a passion for travel mobility, AurumCars is redefining how people rent cars, anywhere, anytime.

🚗 AurumCars – We simplify mobility. Worldwide.
